## Summary

Fixes #2395

The repeated-tool-call breaker (#2247, #2316) was always on and stopped a session after 3 identical failing calls. `gh pr checks` exits with code 8 while checks are pending ([documented](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_pr_checks)), so three ordinary CI polls killed Codex sessions that were only waiting for CI. This happened in [link-assistant/agent#323](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/pull/323#issuecomment-5896427734) and [konard/p-vs-np#623](https://github.com/konard/p-vs-np/pull/623#issuecomment-5897797370).

In p-vs-np#623, the description was rewritten at 20:10:37 without `Fixes #567`, and the auto-merge merged it at 20:11:31 without checking again. Issue #567 stayed open. The log attached at 20:08:58 did not cover the merge.

### Changes

1. **The breaker is opt-in, with a default limit of 10** (`--detect-repeated-tool-calls` / `HIVE_MIND_DETECT_REPEATED_TOOL_CALLS=true`, `--repeated-tool-call-limit` default 10, was 3).
   - CI polling (`gh pr checks`, `gh run view/list/watch`, `gh pr view … statusCheckRollup`, `gh api …/check-runs`, `sleep`, `--watch`, …) is never counted, even when the breaker is enabled.
   - Failing calls only count as repeated when their output repeats too.
   - Applies to every tool: claude, codex, opencode, agent, gemini and qwen. CONFIGURATION docs are updated in all languages.
2. **A breaker stop no longer ends the auto-merge.** The restart-until-mergeable loop attaches the stopped session's log and continues with feedback instead of reporting "🚨 Solution Draft Failed / 🛑 Automation stopped" (`src/solve.auto-merge-session-stop.lib.mjs`).
3. **The issue link is ensured right before every auto-merge.**
   - New `src/pr-issue-link-merge-gate.lib.mjs`, used by both `solve.auto-merge.lib.mjs` and `solve.auto-merge-attempt.lib.mjs` immediately before `mergePullRequest`.
   - A missing `Fixes #N` is restored before the merge.
   - If the description cannot be read or written, the merge is held back (`issue_link_unverified`), and the "auto-merge blocked" comment explains how to fix the description.
4. **The full log is attached again when the auto-merge is held back** (`attachLogAfterAutoMergeBlocked`). This is in addition to the #2306 re-upload after restart loops.
5. **Verbose diagnostic for the unknown 20:10:37 editor.**
   - With `--verbose`, every finished AI session (the first session and each restart iteration) logs the processes still running in its work directory (`src/session-survivors.lib.mjs`).
   - Codex runs tool commands under `setsid()`, so they can outlive the killed process group.
   - Nothing is killed automatically, so legitimate work is never interfered with.

### Case study

[`docs/case-studies/issue-2395/README.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2395-559adda5fe3c/docs/case-studies/issue-2395/README.md) contains:

- the timeline of both incidents,
- every requirement and its status,
- root causes RC1–RC5,
- online facts with sources (gh exit codes, the Codex `setsid` design, command-stream kill semantics),
- the decision on upstream issues (none filed: all upstream behaviour is documented or intentional, and there is no reproducible defect yet),
- the remaining uncertainty.

The raw data is included: both full logs, with the account email and id redacted, plus the PR, comment, edit-history and timeline JSON.

### How to reproduce

```
node experiments/replay-gh-pr-checks-polling-2395.mjs /path/to/v2.33.2/src   # TRIPPED on poll 3 (both runs)
node experiments/replay-gh-pr-checks-polling-2395.mjs                        # not tripped
```

The replay feeds the exact `gh pr checks` records from both logs (`tests/fixtures/issue-2395-*-gh-pr-checks.jsonl`) through the guard.

### Tests

- `tests/repeated-tool-call-opt-in-2395.test.mjs` (14) covers:
  - off by default for every tool,
  - the default limit of 10,
  - polling exemption with the real fixtures,
  - output-sensitive counting,
  - auto-merge continuing with feedback and attaching the stopped session's log.
- `tests/pr-issue-link-before-merge-2395.test.mjs` (13) covers:
  - the gate restoring `Fixes #567` on the exact merged description,
  - fail-closed on read, write and throw errors,
  - both merge paths wired,
  - the blocked comment,
  - the log re-attach on a held-back merge.
- `tests/session-survivors-2395.test.mjs` (7) covers:
  - finding a detached process left in the work directory,
  - verbose-only behaviour,
  - logging format,
  - wiring into every session.
- Updated: `tests/claude-repeated-tool-call-breaker-2247.test.mjs`, `tests/repeated-tool-call-all-tools-2316.test.mjs`, `tests/test-closed-issue-merge-blocking-2144.mjs`.

Locally, all of these pass:

- `npm test` (523 test files),
- `npm run lint`,
- `npm run format:check`,
- `scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`,
- `secretlint`.

### CI note: freshness gate and npm audit

"Checks and release" stopped at `detect-changes` (`Dependency freshness failed: 10 stale`, run 36867760075), and "Security" failed on `npm audit` (run 36867759543). Both came from upstream changes, not from this PR. CI must pass, so they are fixed here in two separate commits:

1. **Gate fix (root cause): `scripts/dependency-freshness.lib.mjs`.** The gate checked `FROM rust:1.98-slim-bookworm` against rust-lang/rust GitHub tags. rust-lang tagged 1.99.0 at 12:41Z, 38 minutes before the run. Docker Hub had not published any `rust:1.99*` image yet, so the only way to pass the gate was a `FROM` line that cannot be pulled. The rust pin is now a `docker` record resolved by `resolveDockerHubLatest('library/rust')`, which returns the newest stable `X.Y.Z` tag the registry actually serves. If the registry returns no versions, the check fails rather than passing. Tests are in `tests/dependency-freshness-2264.test.mjs` and fail without the fix.
2. **Pin refresh.** `@link-assistant/agent` 0.26.8 → 0.26.11 (`Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.dind`), `@sentry/node` and `@sentry/profiling-node` ^11.1.0 → ^11.2.0, `jscpd` ^5.3.3 → ^5.4.0, use-m `@dotenvx/dotenvx` 2.31.1 → 2.32.3. In the lockfile, `brace-expansion` 5.0.9 → 5.0.12 (GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr, GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p). The pin tests are updated to match.

Locally: `node scripts/check-dependency-freshness.mjs` reports 151/151 declarations current, `npm audit --package-lock-only --audit-level=high` finds 0 vulnerabilities, and `npm test` passes all 523 test files. Lint, format and duplication checks also pass.

title: fix: make the repeated-tool-call breaker opt-in and never auto-merge without the issue link (#2395)
